description: This file contains functions for video and image manipulation within the BORIS behavioral observation software, including snapshot capture, zoom level adjustment, rotation, subtitle display, and playback speed control.

methods.name: deinterlace
methods.description: Change the deinterlace status of the video player(s).

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Capture a snapshot of the current video frame or save a copy of the current image.

methods.name: zoom_level
methods.description: Display dialog to set the zoom level for video players.

methods.name: change_player_offset
methods.description: Display dialog to set the time offset for video players.

methods.name: rotate_displayed_video
methods.description: Rotate the displayed video by a selected angle.

methods.name: display_subtitles
methods.description: Display dialog to toggle subtitles visibility for each player.

methods.name: display_zoom_level
methods.description: Update the UI element to show current zoom levels.

methods.name: display_play_rate
methods.description: Update the UI element to show current playback speed.

methods.name: video_normalspeed_activated
methods.description: Set video playback speed to normal (1x).
